title: Le pouverté (Martini)
desc: Johannes Martini, Le pouverté. 3 voices (Cantus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Mar3019); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
